FR-119–122 + FR-24 built the Postgres SqlDriver + all store adapters + PG search, but createSqlDriver() still THROWS for postgres — createFrickServer cannot actually run on PG yet. Four subsystems still read sql.rawDb (sync SQLite) in the FrickStore constructor and must be ported to the async SqlDriver (works on both backends):

1. DevToolsEventStore — DONE (commit b9deb39): record/list/getById/summary/prune/rowCount async; emission fire-and-forget; prune does sequential sweeps (no cross-await txn).
2. SqlitePlatformEventPipeline (apps/server/src/platform-events/sqlite.ts, 516 lines) — claim/deliver use raw BEGIN IMMEDIATE; port to SqlDriver.transaction. NOTE the seam's transaction() uses a #txDepth counter that treats concurrent transactions as NESTED (conflated), not serialized — safe for the serial worker loop, but do not rely on it for true concurrent isolation.
3. AnalyticsEventStore (analytics/consumer.ts + summary.ts, ~575 lines) — port to async SqlDriver.
4. Default search adapter selection — use createPgFtsSearchAdapter(sql) when driver=postgres, createSqliteFtsSearchAdapter(rawDb) otherwise.

Then: keep the SQLite constructor sync (no 108-test ripple) but add async store.initialize() that runs PG framework migrations for the PG path, called from server.listen(); make createSqlDriver return the PG driver for postgres; driver-aware close(); add a createFrickServer-on-PG smoke test gated on FRICK_DATABASE_URL. Unblocks FR-25 (backup/restore parity).
